mcq.s: Which one of the following is scientific computer language?
mcq.x: FORTRAN (Formula Translation), developed by IBM in 1957, was the first high-level language and is used for scientific and numeric work; COBOL is for business.

mcq.s: BASIC is a/an ______ language.
mcq.x: BASIC (Beginner's All-purpose Symbolic Instruction Code) is a procedural language, like C, FORTRAN and PASCAL.

mcq.s: Which of the following is the 5th generation AI programming language?
mcq.x: Fifth-generation languages, used for AI and logic programming, include Prolog (and Mercury, OPS5); SQL is 4GL and C/C++ are 3GL.

mcq.s: The work of assembler is:
o: Convert basic language into machine language
Convert high level language into machine language
Convert assembly language into machine language
Convert assembly language into high level language
mcq.x: An assembler converts assembly language (mnemonics) into machine language; a compiler or interpreter translates high-level languages.

mcq.s: Language that the computers can understand and execute is called:
mcq.x: Machine language (only 0s and 1s) is the only language a computer understands and runs directly, without a translator.

mcq.s: The machine language of computer is based on:
mcq.x: Machine language works with binary 0 and 1, which follow Boolean algebra (George Boole's AND, OR, NOT logic).

mcq.s: On which principle does a digital computer work?
mcq.x: A digital computer works on the logical principle – binary 0/1 and Boolean logic (AND, OR, NOT); analog computers work by measurement.

mcq.s: If a domain name ends with .edu.us, then it is:
mcq.x: .edu marks an educational institution and .us the United States, so .edu.us is an educational institute in the USA (.au is Australia).

mcq.s: In the website of an organization ‘.com’ indicates:
mcq.x: .com, a top-level domain of the Domain Name System, stands for commercial.

mcq.s: Which of the following is a valid domain name extension?
mcq.x: .com (commercial), .gov (government) and .net (network) are all valid top-level domain extensions.

mcq.s: The place where accessories are connected in computer is known as:
mcq.x: A port is the interface on a computer where peripherals such as the monitor, keyboard, mouse or printer are connected (e.g. USB port).

mcq.s: Which infotech term is used to find out a user's e-mail address?
mcq.x: Finger is a protocol/command used to find a user's e-mail address and login details; Archie searches FTP files.

mcq.s: Which work is not done by a computer?
mcq.x: A computer inputs, processes, computes and outputs data, but it has no intelligence of its own – it does not 'understand'.

why: the app already asks 'A fault in a computer program which prevents it from working correctly is known as – Bug'

mcq.s: Which industry is the primary user of Magnetic Ink Character Recognition (MICR)?
mcq.x: MICR (Magnetic Ink Character Recognition) reads the magnetic-ink characters printed at the bottom of cheques – it is used mainly by banks.

mcq.s: O.M.R. stands for:
mcq.x: OMR = Optical Mark Reader (Recognition): reads pen or pencil marks made in fixed positions on forms, such as objective answer sheets.

mcq.s: Which one is mainly used in checking of objective type answer paper in the examination?
mcq.x: OMR (Optical Mark Reader) is used to check objective-type answer sheets; MICR is used for bank cheques and OCR for printed text.

mcq.s: I.R.C. stands for:
mcq.x: IRC = Internet Relay Chat, an application-layer protocol for real-time text chat over the internet.

mcq.s: C.A.D. stands for:
mcq.x: CAD = Computer-Aided Design: software used by architects and engineers for precise 2D drawings and 3D models.

mcq.s: A computer derives its strength from:
mcq.x: A computer's strength comes from its speed, accuracy and memory (storage) – all of these.

mcq.s: The ability of an operating system to run more than one application at a time is called:
mcq.x: Multitasking is an operating system's ability to run more than one application at a time (Windows is a multitasking OS).

mcq.s: When information is dialled on the telephone and read on a screen at the other end, it is known as:
mcq.x: Telefax (fax) sends text and pictures over telephone lines to be read at the other end; the fax was invented by Alexander Bain in 1842.

mcq.s: What can we send through video mail?
mcq.x: Video mail sends a pre-recorded video by e-mail; it can carry graphics, video clips and video messages.

why: answer not sure: 'video chat' also gives audio and video conversation

mcq.s: Video conferencing is:
o: Conduct of video calls using telecom technology
Conduct of a video conference using a set of telescopes
mcq.x: Video conferencing is the conduct of live video calls between two or more places using telecommunication technology, with two-way video and audio.

mcq.s: Which of the following devices is compulsory for video conferencing?
mcq.x: Video conferencing needs a webcam (video camera) for video input, plus a display, microphone and speakers.

mcq.s: Which of the following is not an essential component required for the video conferencing system?
mcq.x: A video conferencing system needs a video camera, a display device and a microphone (with speakers and a network); a telephone is not essential.

mcq.s: E-Mail stands for:
mcq.x: E-mail stands for Electronic Mail – exchanging digital messages over a computer network.

mcq.s: What are the two parts of e-mail address?
mcq.x: An e-mail address has two parts, the user name and the domain name, joined by @ (username@domainname.extension).

mcq.s: The domain name of the e-mail address mark.sttol@ITdesk.info is:
mcq.x: In an e-mail address the part after @ is the domain name, so in mark.sttol@ITdesk.info it is ITdesk.info.

mcq.s: Which of the following is free e-mail service provider?
mcq.x: Hotmail, Rediffmail and Yahoo (like Gmail) are all free e-mail service providers.

mcq.s: What kind of digital files can be attached to the e-mail?
mcq.x: Any digital file – documents, photos, music, audio or video – can be sent as an e-mail attachment.

mcq.s: What is singular of data?
mcq.x: Datum is the singular of data – a single piece of information or fact.

mcq.s: Word 'blog' is combination of two words:
mcq.x: 'Blog' comes from 'web log' – a web page kept as a public journal; its writer is a blogger.

mcq.s: ______ is the process of carrying out commands.
mcq.x: The CPU cycle is fetch → decode → execute → store; executing is the stage of carrying out the commands.

mcq.s: A ‘menu’ contains a list of:
mcq.x: In a program a menu is a list of commands (options) the user can choose from.

mcq.s: ______ is a way to quickly access a favourite website by saving it in your browser.
mcq.x: A bookmark saves a website's address in the browser so the favourite page can be opened again quickly; a cookie is data a site stores in the browser.

mcq.s: The full form of SIM is:
mcq.x: SIM = Subscriber Identity Module, the small card holding a mobile subscriber's identity that lets the phone attach to the network.

mcq.s: A computer hacker (in the security sense) is:
o: A person who maintains computer security
A person who violates computer security with malicious intent
A person responsible for safe computer operation
mcq.x: A security hacker uses technical skill and software bugs or exploits to break into computer systems without authorisation; hacking is a cyber security concern.

mcq.s: The term _____ refers to an individual who breaks into computer systems without authorisation and deliberately defaces websites for fraudulent purposes.
mcq.x: A cracker (black hat hacker) breaks into computers or networks with malicious intent; a white hat is an ethical hacker who tests security with permission.

mcq.s: Basic Input-Output system in computer resides:
mcq.x: The BIOS (Basic Input-Output System) firmware resides in ROM, so it is available as soon as the computer is switched on.

mcq.s: Networking of computers:
mcq.x: Networking computers lets them share information and resources – raising their utility and access to information – but also raises security threats such as hacking and viruses.
